id: \bSo you made it to the top? You can make a wish, but I've already got it ready for you.
en: \bSo you made it to the top? You can make a wish, but I've already got it ready for you.
it: \bCe l'hai fatta ad arrivare in cima? Puoi esprimere un desiderio, ma te l'ho già preparato.

id: \bNo need to thank me. Making wishes come true is my wish.
en: \bNo need to thank me. Making wishes come true is my wish.
it: \bNon c'è bisogno di ringraziarmi. Realizzare i desideri è il mio desiderio.
